newsitem.title: UK: Weak New York futures subdue Liverpool cotton.
newsitem.headline: Weak New York futures subdue Liverpool cotton.

text.p: The main feature of the market remained the weakness of New York futures and the lack, therefore, of any incentive for mill buyers to resume purchasing on any significant scale.
Spnners in many markets are presumed to need fair quantities of cotton to meet shipment requirements through to the movement of the northern hemisphere 1997/98 crops.

Sporadic additional purchases have been mentioned in selected upland styles, mainly of Central Asian and West African origin. Italian mills have also shown a selective interest in Turkish descriptions.
